exposure: Risk factors for stress urinary incontinence (SUI)
outcome: Impact of SUI on quality of life (QoL)
cohort: Primigravid women who delivered in the study hospital during 2007, with 318 completing questionnaires 12 years later.
finding: The cumulative incidence of SUI increased markedly from 6 months (14.2%) to 12 years postpartum (39.6%), and developing SUI during pregnancy doubled the risk of SUI 12 years postpartum (OR: 2.14).
